paragraphs.text: Monthly membership costs £29 and includes the gym, the pool and all classes except personal training. There is no joining fee if you sign up online. Members may bring one guest a month for £5.
Membership can be frozen for up to three months a year, for example during an injury, but a note from a doctor is needed for longer. Cancellation requires thirty days’ notice.

items.quote: includes the gym, the pool and all classes except personal training
items.prompt: Personal training is included in the monthly price.

items.quote: There is no joining fee if you sign up online
items.prompt: Joining online avoids an extra charge.

explanation.en: Online sign-up has no joining fee → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Онлайн болса, кіру жарнасы жоқ → TRUE.

items.quote: frozen for up to three months a year, for example during an injury, but a note from a doctor is needed for longer
items.prompt: A doctor’s note is needed to freeze membership for two months.

explanation.en: Up to three months needs no note, and two months is less → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Үш айға дейін анықтама қажет емес, екі ай — үштен аз → FALSE.
explanation.ru: До трёх месяцев справка не нужна, два месяца — меньше трёх → FALSE.

items.quote: Members may bring one guest a month for £5

explanation.en: What a guest may use is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Қонақ немен пайдалана алатыны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Про то, чем гость может пользоваться, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
